headlines.title: Sen. Bill Cassidy, a critical Republican holdout, backs Todd Blanche for attorney general
headlines.description: Republican Sens. Lisa Murkowski of Alaska and Susan Collins of Maine said they would oppose Blanche. But Cassidy’s support means he will likely be confirmed.

headlines.description: WASHINGTON — The Senate voted overwhelmingly to pass legislation to impose sanctions against Russia and Iran after months of fits and starts, with the death of Republican Sen.

headlines.title: Desperate water shortage in Puerto Rico
headlines.description: A major humanitarian crisis is unfolding in a San Juan, Puerto Rico. Hundreds of thousands of people in and around the American city are facing rolling water shutoffs brought on by an historic drought. NBC News’ George Solis is on the ground there tonight.

headlines.title: Psychiatrists who treated Lindsay Clancy testify at murder trial
headlines.description: The trial of a mother accused of killing her three children has wrapped its second week. Two psychiatrists who treated Lindsay Clancy before her children's death testified in court today. NBC News' Steven Romo and legal analyst Misty Marris break down the doctors' testimony.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Parents outraged after sex assault case against their daughter’s ex is dismissed without jail time
headlines.description: The parents of an Oklahoma teenager who accused her former boyfriend of sexual assault and strangulation say they were misled about how his case would be resolved — and that the final outcome allowing him to bypass jail without admitting any guilt was far too lenient.

headlines.title: 78-year-old stabbed by teen in clown costume was likely making surprise visit to sister
headlines.description: A 78-year-old man was likely making one of his regular, unannounced visits to his older sister when he tragically crossed paths with a knife-wielding teenager in a clown costume, the victim’s family said Friday.

headlines.title: Fault lines for both parties emerge after Michigan’s primaries: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, Kristen Welker looks ahead to November in swing state Michigan after this week’s primary battles.

headlines.title: Maine surgical nurse released from immigration detention following outcry
headlines.description: A registered nurse is back with her family after a weeklong fight with the support of community members and colleagues from Maine Medical Center, who demanded she be released from immigration detention.

headlines.title: Idaho police release chilling new video of In-N-Out mass shooting
headlines.description: Police released new surveillance footage of the mass shooting at an In-N-Out in Twin Falls, Idaho, showing the clearest account yet of the horrific scene.

headlines.title: Woman sues Yankees for $10M after getting struck by bat, says she suffered brain injury
headlines.description: A New Jersey woman is suing the New York Yankees for $10 million after a bat flew into the stands and struck her in the head, which she says gave her a brain injury.
